verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe rigidbody, collision, and joint components built on ammo.js (a WebAssembly Bullet physics port), giving out-of-the-box rigid body and collision support via standard components. Raycasting is a well-known standard feature of PlayCanvas but is not explicitly documented in this evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit raycast API documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of physics reliability/performance.
